sections.content: You know the *indefinido* and the *imperfecto* from A2 Unit 22 (the preterite vs the imperfect). This lesson uses them to tell the story of a move: the *indefinido* for events that happened (*me mudé*) and the *imperfecto* for background and circumstances (*no conocía a nadie*).

items.spanish: En 2018 me mudé a otro país.
items.english: In 2018 I moved to another country.

items.spanish: Al principio no conocía a nadie.
items.english: At first I did not know anyone.

items.spanish: Vivía con mi familia cuando llegamos.
items.english: I was living with my family when we arrived.

sections.content: Build a narrative by combining background with completed events.
